entities.summary: Nathaniel P. Tallmadge was an American lawyer, politician, and Wisconsin pioneer. He served two terms as United States senator from New York and was the 3rd governor of the Wisconsin Territory (1844–1845). Originally active in politics as a Jacksonian Democrat, he fell out with the party during the presidency of Martin Van Buren and eventually became a Whig.
